(Iron Man). While HAL 9000 is an older AI assistant, it is often used in stories as a cautionary example of AI with human-like intelligence and emotions. rows.name: siri apple inc
rows.description: Siri is an artificial intelligence personal assistant program available on several Apple products including the iPhone, iPad, iPod, Mac, Apple Watch, and CarPlay as well as some Apple TV models. rows.name: google assistant

Google Assistant interprets text requests on iOS and other devices using the voice commands that are integrated into its Google Mobile Services. Google Assistant also interprets users' requests on Google Chrome, by its digital assistants, Allo, and Lens and on wearables, such as Google Glass or smartwatches
